brief:
The body referred to as the "Peace Council," Shehab Wire reported, has announced opposition to UNRWA, the United Nations relief organization established by international decision in 1949 following the Palestinian displacement. The council characterized its stance as hostility toward the Palestinian Arab people and against UN resolutions.

UNRWA was founded in response to the circumstances of the Palestinian catastrophe, according to the report.
